correctness.rationale: The corrected Finding and scope require a nonzero class, so that the intersection is a curve. Independently formed the rational evaluation and differential-restriction matrices on all 35 quartic monomials. Evaluation has rank 15; the 20-dimensional kernel has differential image of rank 16, with the four multiples of G exactly the remaining kernel. Enumerating its tangent data and separately backtracking over graph matchings gave the same set of 288 vectors bijectively. Acting directly on matchings by symplectic transvections gave two 144-element orbits. Lifted representatives gave four unit Jacobian ideals for the smooth orbit and nonunit ideals for the other. Independent pairwise comparison reproduced all nine histogram entries for the 10,296 distinct smooth pairs, with no zero agreement. At a rational point, a tangent kernel identifies its nonzero binary linear functional on the surface tangent space, so agreement is equivalent to the sum having zero differential there. The matching graph's cross-edges give exactly 36 connected alternating 8-cycles, and the two extra neighbors of each singular vertex make a 4-cycle within that component. Each spanning 8-cycle bounds its independence number by four, attained by the smooth part. These checks use the repaired nonzero/proper-section convention throughout and verify the unchanged spectrum and pencil and graph assertions.
residual_risks: The pencil statement concerns only the three nonzero F2 members within the given system and does not quantify over higher-degree, other-surface, or extension-field pencils.
